label: Pregnant adult characters — sex / intimate scenes (25 Oct 2026)
description: Adult, visibly pregnant female characters in sex or intimate scenes, found via TV Tropes, press articles, Wikipedia search and recaps; partner, outcome and prior kids recorded. Existing cards were enriched, not duplicated. Plot-level notes only; minors, violent and fake-pregnancy cases excluded.

records.title: Munich
records.summary: Mossad agent Avner and his seven-month-pregnant wife Daphna share a brief, careful love scene before he accepts a mission; she asks how late in pregnancy they can continue and he reminds her he won't be around.
records.pregnancy_outcome: Daphna gives birth to a daughter while Avner is abroad
records.evidence: Multi-source (screenplay text, Wikipedia, Slate, TV Tropes)

records.title: St. Vincent
records.character: Daka (Naomi Watts), pregnant sex worker / stripper
records.summary: Cranky Vincent keeps seeing Daka, a pregnant Russian stripper and sex worker, even while she is visibly pregnant; the film shows a brief, non-explicit encounter between them.
records.pregnancy_note: Partner in scene: Vincent MacKenna (client); father of her baby not stated in sources used
records.evidence: Multi-source (Plugged In, IMDb plot, Wikipedia, TV Tropes); outcome not verified

records.title: Little Fires Everywhere — “The Uncanny” (S1E6)
records.summary: In Mia's flashback she is a pregnant surrogate and becomes intimate with her professor Pauline; after her brother dies and her parents reject her she lies that she miscarried and drives away to have the baby.
records.pregnancy_outcome: Mia keeps the baby and gives birth to Pearl
records.pregnancy_note: Partner in scene: Pauline Hawthorne (female lover / mentor); baby is the surrogacy couple's embryo that Mia keeps
records.evidence: Multi-source recaps; intimacy level described as tender, scene detail from summaries

records.title: Dickinson — “‘Hope’ is the thing with feathers” (S3E1)
records.summary: Heavily pregnant Sue arrives and she and Emily share a tender kiss and quiet intimacy upstairs; Sue says she loves Emily and wants them to raise the baby together while Emily worries about what the pregnancy will change.
records.pregnancy_note: Partner in scene: Emily Dickinson; Sue's husband Austin says he does not know whether the baby is his

sources.label: YouTube: Emily and Sue pregnant scene S03E01

records.evidence: Recaps + YouTube clip; outcome not verified here

records.title: Virgin River — Season 4 (E3 “Grilled”, E10 “Fire and Rain”)
records.summary: Mel is pregnant and unsure who the father is; she and Jack share an intimate scene in episode 3 and reconnect with a love scene in episode 10 after Jack agrees to a paternity test.
records.pregnancy_outcome: S4 finale confirms Jack is the father and the baby is a girl; in S5E5 Mel miscarries

records.title: Mad About You — “The Birth” (S5)
records.fit_note: Single-source: TV Tropes records that, overdue, she and Paul have sex to induce labor; the scene is sitcom-level.
records.summary: Overdue and eager for labor, Jamie and her husband Paul have sex in an attempt to induce it; earlier in the pregnancy Paul had been reluctant until her doctor reassured them.
records.pregnancy_outcome: Jamie gives birth to daughter Mabel
